pattern: ^(?:Find|Take|Start with|Determine) the (?P<pick>larger|smaller) root of x\^2 -(?P<b>\d+)x \+(?P<c>\d+) = 0\.\s+Using that as the acceleration in m/s\^2 of a (?P<m>\d+) kg mass, find the force\.\s+(?:Convert that to|Express the result in) kN from N(?:, in kN)?\.$

name: fable:choose_interest_add
pattern: ^(?:Compute|Take) (?P<n>\d+) choose (?P<r>\d+)\.\s+Using that as a principal in dollars, find the simple interest at (?P<rate>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)% per year over (?P<t>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) years\.\s+Add (?P<d>\d+) to that(?:, in \$)?\.$

name: fable:sumk2_interest_subtract
pattern: ^Compute the sum of k\^2 for k = 1 to (?P<n>\d+)\.\s+Using that as a principal in dollars, find the simple interest at (?P<rate>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)% per year over (?P<t>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) years\.\s+Subtract (?P<d>\d+) from that(?:, in \$)?\.$
